_meta.milestone: M2c (fully merged). v10, pending verification: more aggressive bots: personality shares 0.5/0.35/0.15, investigateChance 0.9/0.6/0.2, retreatBelowHp balanced 30 / cautious 45, investigateMinEagerness 0.3 (bots._aggressionNote, systems/combat.md 'Balance v10'). v9, pending verification: zone waits P1 75 -> 60, P2 70 -> 50, P3 65 -> 45 (both maps), sniper helmet cap only for helmet tier >= 2, DMR 50 -> 44, frag maxDamage 120 -> 140, paddle 94 -> 78 (systems/combat.md 'Balance v9'). v8 (zone waits +25 s after the bot zone-entry fix) was the M2c QA baseline before it.
_meta.units: Distances in metres, speeds in m/s, accelerations in m/s^2, angles in degrees, times in ms unless the key ends in Seconds. Damage and health are HP points. Keys that start with an underscore are documentation and code should ignore them.
_meta.spec: docs/design/GDD.md, docs/design/systems/*.md (M2a: combat.md, armor.md, stance.md, grenades.md, loot.md; M2b: maps.md, drop.md, rooms.md, camera.md; M2c: levels.md, melee.md, rpg.md, smoke.md, layout.md)
_meta._m2cPendingNote: M2c (ADR 0007 section 11). v5 = merge step 1: every new M2c key and block is live (combat.throwableCycleMs, levels, scopes, layout, loot.guaranteedWeapon, weapons.revolver/dbshotgun/rpg/knife/machete/paddle, items.ammo_rocket/vest_4/helmet_4/smoke, bots.melee/rpg/smoke/scopes, bots.weaponPrefs.revolver/dbshotgun, bots.personalities.*.smokeChanceMultiplier, clientFeel.fpRecoil.revolver/dbshotgun/rpg, maps.office.layout, maps.office.loot.guaranteedWeapon). v6 = merge step 2 (loot.tiers.*, maps.office.loot.tiers.*, bots.eagernessCurve) plus tuning round 1 from the first pacing run (see the _tuning / _eagernessNote / _lootTiersTuning keys); _m2cPending is gone. L1 level multipliers are exactly 1, so every pre-M2c weapon number is its L1 value.
_meta._m2aRemoved: M2a removed player.maxArmor, items.vest and the armor.absorbFraction key. Armor is now per piece: items.vest_1..3 and items.helmet_1..3 {slot, tier, durability, absorbFraction}. See systems/armor.md.
_meta._m2bRemoved: M2b removed clientFeel.fpFovDefault, fpFovMin, fpFovMax and fpFovReferenceAspect. The FOV setting range is FP_FOV_MIN_DEG / FP_FOV_MAX_DEG / DEFAULT_FP_FOV_DEG / FP_FOV_REFERENCE_ASPECT in src/shared/contracts.ts (ADR 0005 section 9).
_meta._mapsNote: M2b (systems/maps.md section 3, ADR 0005 section 4): maps.<mapId> holds per-map overrides, deep-merged over the base sections for every match on that map (balanceForMap). Objects merge key by key; arrays (zone.phases) and scalars replace wholesale. Only keys that differ from the base. zoneTheme is a required per-map key, not an override. Forbidden per map: net, maps, rooms, match.maxPlayers, match.minHumansToStart, match.countdownSeconds, match.mapVoteLockSeconds. Base sections = the island.

match._mapVoteNote: M2b (maps.md 1.3, rooms.md): the map vote locks, and the map and carrier route are resolved, mapVoteLockSeconds before the countdown ends. Lobby-time key, not overridable per map. minHumansToStart is superseded inside rooms by rooms.minHumansToStartWith(out)Bots.

player._note: height, eyeHeight and headZoneFraction are the STANDING values and must equal movement.stances.stand.height / eyeHeight. Crouch and prone hitboxes: combat.hitbox and movement.stances.

stances._note: systems/stance.md. height = hitbox and collision height (feet to top); eyeHeight = shot origin, line of sight and camera pivot. Ground speed = base speed x speedMultiplier (x ADS, heal, water and fire multipliers; see stance.md 'Speed formula'). transitionMs keys are '<from>_<to>'. During a transition: speed uses the lower speedMultiplier of the two stances, the hitbox and collision height use the taller stance, eyeHeight lerps linearly. Water depth = max(0, -terrainHeight) at the feet. M2b: pronePitchMinDeg/MaxDeg clamp the SIM pitch while the stance is prone or a transition has prone at either end (systems/camera.md); stand and crouch keep PITCH_MIN/MAX.
stances._bug008: BUG-008 (stance.md 'Visual fit'): prone.height 0.5 -> 0.6 so a chibi head centred on the prone eye (0.35) fits the box with the same ~0.1 m overhang as standing (1.39 vs 1.30). Crouch stays 0.95 (office low cover: boxSmall 0.99 hides a crouched player). The poses move to the sim, not the reverse.

drop._note: M2b carrier drop (systems/drop.md). Base values = island; office overrides go in maps.office.drop (systems/maps.md). Altitude is absolute y. Freefall uses freefallSpeed/freefallSteerSpeed; the parachute phase uses movement.dropFallSpeed/dropSteerSpeed. chuteDeployHeight is measured above the terrain/floor below (props ignored). Route: heading uniform 0-360, lateral offset uniform within +-routeLateralFraction x support(normal); entry/exit where the line meets the play area expanded by routeEntryMargin; eject where it leaves the play area inset by ejectInset; redraw up to routeMaxTries until the jump window >= minJumpWindowMetres. match.dropHeight is no longer used for the match start.

combat._spreadNote: Cone half-angle = spreadDeg x A x S x M x J. A = 1 + (adsSpreadMultiplier - 1) x adsProgress. S = stanceSpreadMultiplier[stance] when the stance is settled, 1 during a transition. M = moveSpreadMultiplier when horizontal speed > moveSpreadSpeedThreshold. J = airSpreadMultiplier when airborne. No clamps. combat.md 'Spread'.
combat._throwableNote: M2c (grenades.md 'Throwable slot'): pressing 4/G while the throwable slot is already held and ready cycles to the next carried type; the cycle takes throwableCycleMs (no fire, no throw). Selecting the slot from another slot still costs combat.swapMs.
combat._helmetHeadshotCapNote: Damage pass 2026-11, narrowed in v9: a headshot from a weapon in helmetHeadshotCap.weapons on a player wearing a helmet with durability > 0 AND tier >= minHelmetTier takes HP loss min(normal HP loss after the helmet, maxHpLoss). The helmet absorbs as usual (armor.md) and usually breaks or is badly damaged, so the next headshot kills. A full-HP player in helmet_2 or better survives a sniper headshot at every level. helmet_1 is below minHelmetTier and gets no cap: an L1 sniper headshot (176) through a fresh helmet_1 (absorbs 30) is 146 HP loss and kills. systems/combat.md 'Sniper rules'.

hitbox._note: Stand: vertical cylinder radius player.radius, height stances.stand.height, head = top player.headZoneFraction. Crouch: same cylinder with height stances.crouch.height, head = top crouchHeadZoneFraction. Prone: level box centred on the feet (x, z), long axis along the look yaw, proneLength x proneWidth x stances.prone.height; head = the front proneHeadLength metres (toward the look direction). During a transition: the cylinder of the taller stance.

weapons._note: sight: none | iron | red_dot | scope_4x | scope_8x. adsZoom divides clientFeel.cameraFovDeg at full ADS. adsSpreadMultiplier is the A term at adsProgress 1. adsMoveMultiplier scales ground speed while ADS is engaged. adsTimeMs = time from 0 to full ADS (exit is instant). fireMoveMultiplier scales ground speed for combat.fireMoveWindowMs after each shot (LMG only, 1 elsewhere). Shots-to-kill tables: combat.md.

rifle._m2aNote: History: M2a nerf (the M1 rifle took most kills): damage 22 -> 19, headshotMultiplier 1.75 -> 1.8 (kept 3 headshots lethal), hip spreadDeg 1.0 -> 1.6 (needs ADS for range), falloff 40/110/0.7 -> 30/90/0.65, loot weights cut. The damage pass 2026-11 then raised damage 19 -> 23 (current value; 3 headshots = 124.2).

lmg._note: Planted suppression gun: highest sustained DPS and a 60 round mag, but wide hip spread, the worst moving spread, a 5 s reload, slow ADS, and fireMoveMultiplier 0.55 while firing. Best prone (spread x 0.6).

dmr._note: Semi-auto marksman rifle. Poor hip fire (3.0 deg), pin-point scoped (0.3 deg). Damage pass 2026-11: 42 -> 50 (2 body shots in 0.4 s out to 80 m, which out-performed the sniper). v9: 50 -> 44, so 3 body (0.8 s) / 2 head unarmored, and head 77 + body 44 kills. L4 (x1.15 = 50.6) still 2-taps an unarmored body.

sniper._note: Bolt-action: fireIntervalMs (1400) IS the bolt cycle; the scope stays up while the bolt cycles. No falloff (falloffStart = falloffEnd = range, minDamageFactor 1) so the one-shot rules hold at every range. Damage pass 2026-11: base 80 -> 88; L1-L3 go up, L4 stays at 96 body / 192 head (levels.overrides.sniper). Body never kills a full-HP player at any level; a head with no helmet or helmet_1 kills (v9); a head in helmet_2+ is capped by combat.helmetHeadshotCap. Arithmetic in combat.md.

weapons._meleeNote: M2c (systems/melee.md). Melee entries (MeleeId: knife, machete, paddle) keep the WeaponBalance shape. fireIntervalMs IS the swing cycle (click to next swing); range IS the reach (m, from the eye along the aim); hitFrameMs = time from the click to the single hit check; sweepRadius = capsule radius around the aim segment; knockbackSpeed (m/s, horizontal, along the attacker's yaw) and knockbackLift (m/s up, not applied to prone targets) are added to the target's velocity on a hit. falloffStart = falloffEnd = range and minDamageFactor 1 = no falloff. sight none, no ammo, no ADS, no right-click action. They live in slot 2 (the fists slot) and never take a gun slot.
weapons._rpgNote: M2c (systems/rpg.md). weapons.rpg.damage IS the direct-hit impact damage (body zone, vest absorbs); range IS the rocket's max travel distance (it air-bursts there). rocket.* = projectile and blast. Blast uses the grenade blast model (grenades.md 'Explosion') with rocket.blast.*; blast maxDamage scales with the level damage multiplier. A rocket that hits anything before travelling armDistance metres is a dud: impact damage only, no blast.

revolver._note: M2c heavy pistol (damage pass 2026-11: 38 -> 46): 3 body / 2 head unarmored, 6 rounds of ammo_heavy, slow trigger. The skill sidearm of the common pool.

dbshotgun._note: M2c double barrel: 10 pellets x 14 = 140 at point blank (damage pass 2026-11: 12 -> 14) (one-shots an unarmored body; both barrels kill any armor within ~3 m in 0.25 s). Very wide cone and steep falloff: about 15 damage per barrel at 8 m. 2 shells, slow reload. One barrel per click.

paddle._note: v9: damage 94 -> 78, its value before the damage pass 2026-11. An L4 body hit (97.5) no longer one-shots an unarmored player, and an L1 headshot (117) through a fresh helmet_1 is 87 HP loss, not a kill. systems/melee.md.

items._armorNote: systems/armor.md. Per hit on the covered zone: a = min(durability, dmg x absorbFraction); durability -= a; hp -= dmg - a. A piece at 0 durability is destroyed (tier 0). Design invariant (keeps 'effective HP = 100 + durability'): durability < 100 x absorbFraction / (1 - absorbFraction). Vest covers body hits and grenades; helmet covers head hits only.

grenade._note: systems/grenades.md. Throw speed = lerp(throwSpeedMin, throwSpeedMax, t), t = clamp((pitchDeg - throwPitchMinDeg) / (throwPitchMaxDeg - throwPitchMinDeg), 0, 1), x throwSpeedProneMultiplier when settled prone. Launch pitch = aim pitch + throwLiftDeg (max 89). radius is the BLAST radius; collisionRadius is the physics radius. dangerMargin: the HUD danger indicator shows live grenades within radius + dangerMargin metres of the local player (client only). Damage at 3D distance d from the blast to the target's chest: maxDamage if d <= innerRadius, else lerp(1, minDamageFactor, (d - innerRadius) / (radius - innerRadius)) x maxDamage, 0 beyond radius. No armTime: frags only explode on fuse. v9: maxDamage 120 -> 140 to keep pace with the damage pass (at 120, 52 island explosions gave 0 kills); it now also kills a fresh vest_1 within 1.39 m (grenades.md).

smoke._note: M2c (systems/smoke.md). Same throw formula, flight physics and bounce rules as items.grenade (grenades.md), with these values. cookable false: the fuse starts at release and nothing is consumed until release. At fuse end the canister is removed and a cloud is created. Cloud = a sphere centred centerHeight above the deploy point (water: above y = 0). Opaque radius r(t), t = ms since deploy: t < growMs: radius x t / growMs; t < growMs + holdMs: radius; t < growMs + holdMs + fadeMs: radius x (1 - (t - growMs - holdMs) / fadeMs); then removed. closeSightRange: two points closer than this see each other through smoke (bots, name tags). maxActive: at most this many clouds; a new one makes the oldest start its fade at once.

armor._note: General armor rules (per-piece numbers live in items.vest_N / items.helmet_N). dropOnDeath: worn pieces with durability > 0 drop as pickups on death with their remaining durability.

loot._tiersNote: M2c tables (merge step 2, tuned after the first pacing run). Sums: common 83, rare 110, epic 107. Plain common guns (pistol 6, revolver 4, smg 5, shotgun 3, rifle 2) were raised back from 15 to 20 after matchReport showed unarmed bots crowding the few guns in the loot phase (island first kill 37 s, median 338 s). The 12 / 16 guaranteed-weapon points (loot.guaranteedWeapon) supply the rest of the early guns. Expected counts per map: loot.md 'M2c expected items per match'. Weapon levels are rolled from levels.lootTiers; scopes have no level.

guaranteedWeapon._note: M2c (loot.md 'Guaranteed weapons', layout.md, levels/variety.md): loot points flagged guarantee 'weapon' always spawn (spawnChance 1) one gun rolled from weights, at a level rolled from levels (relative weights L1..L4: L1-L2 only), plus the normal extraAmmoWithWeapon stacks. They count as common points in layout.lootUsedPerTier. Per-map override: maps.<id>.loot.guaranteedWeapon.

levels._note: M2c (systems/levels.md). Every weapon except fists has a level 1-4 (ItemLevel). Effective stat = weapons.<id>.<field> x multiplier[level - 1]. Each array has 4 entries; index 0 (L1) must be exactly 1, and every entry must be in [0.5, 2]. Per field the multiplier comes from overrides.<id>.<field> if present, else the class default (gun = every weapon with ammo != null, melee = knife/machete/paddle) if present, else 1. Scalable fields: damage (for the rpg it also scales rocket.blast.maxDamage), reloadMs, fireIntervalMs (for melee it also scales hitFrameMs), spreadDeg. No rounding; the 30 Hz tick quantises times. lootTiers.<tier> = relative weights of L1..L4 for any weapon rolled at a loot spot of that tier (armor is not rolled: its level is the id suffix). botValueMultiplier: bots multiply a weapon's lootValue by this for its level.

overrides._note: Damage pass 2026-11 raised base damage about 20% (shotgun 11 -> 13, so all 9 pellets (117) now one-shot an unarmored body at point blank). shotgun: damage flat across levels; levels tighten the cone and the pump instead. dmr: damage capped at x1.15; the trigger gets faster instead. sniper: base 88 with [1, 1.03, 1.06, 96/88] so L1-L3 rise (88 / 90.6 / 93.3) and L4 stays exactly 96 body / 192 head, the pre-pass value. rpg: x1.15 on the direct hit and the blast (damage pass 2026-11: direct 40 -> 48, blast 110 -> 132; an L4 direct hit plus blast now kills through a fresh vest_3).

levels._lootTiersTuning: Pacing run 1: L4 was ~3% of guns but 10-17% of island kills (winners keep the best gun from death drops). Rare L4 3 -> 2 and epic L4 20 -> 15 (about 0.56 L4 guns per match instead of 0.77); target L4 <= 12% of kills.

scopes._note: M2c (systems/scopes.md). ScopeId items mount on guns and set the gun's sight. scope_<x>.sight = the SightType it gives, zoom = adsZoom while mounted (replaces weapons.<id>.adsZoom). No item levels. sightFactors.<SightType>: with a scope mounted, the gun's adsTimeMs, adsSpreadMultiplier and adsMoveMultiplier become base x factor[mounted sight] / factor[the gun's default sight] (so a gun with its default sight is unchanged). rank orders sights for auto-mount (a pickup auto-mounts only on a gun whose current sight rank is lower). compatible.<GunId> = ScopeIds that gun accepts; the gun's default sight is never listed (removing the scope returns to it); 4x/8x only on rails >= 0.17 m (art M2c 14.2). Guns not listed and melee accept none. spareSlots: shared spare-scope pouch size (UI scopeStashMax). swapMs: time of the T sight switch (timed; no fire, no ADS; T while ADS is ignored).

layout._note: M2c (systems/layout.md; level-designer owns candidates, groups and arrangements in levels/variety.md). lootUsedPerTier = loot points activated per match per tier (each then rolls loot.spawnChance, except guaranteed-weapon points); the sum of MapData loot-group use counts must equal it (data test). lootCandidateFactorMin: every loot group has at least ceil(use x factor) candidates and at least use + 1, except groups the level data marks fixed (with a fixedNote; e.g. the office SW perch epic, 1 of 1). minLootSpacing: minimum metres between any two activated loot points (level data may be stricter: island uses 2.5). minCoverFraction: every arrangement of a POI or desk zone keeps at least this fraction of the largest arrangement's blocking collider footprint.

grass._note: Island v2 tall grass (user request 2026-11-22: grass on the island players can hide in; systems/grass.md). 'grass' props are soft (no collider: they never stop movement, bullets, grenades or blasts). Hidden = feet at least edgeInset m inside a patch AND crouched or prone (settled, or moving between crouch and prone; standing or a transition from/to stand is never hidden) AND the viewer is farther than revealRange m (horizontal) AND no shot in the last revealAfterShotMs. Hidden players are invisible to bots (target pick, retaliation) and their model and name tag fade out for other players. Patch size is level data (GRASS_PATCH_RADIUS 2.5 m x placement scale, src/shared/grass.ts).

zone._islandGrowthNote: Island v2 (2026-11-22, user request: island 50% bigger; levels/island.md): coast 110 -> 165 m, world edge 135 -> 190 m, so startRadius 125 -> 180 (covers the 164 m worst-case coast). Phase fractions retuned so the middle circles grow with the island (P1-P3 126 / 90 / 59 m, were 88 / 65 / 47.5) while the endgame circles keep about their old size (P4-P6 31 / 14 / 5 m, were 27.5 / 14 / 5). Pending a matchReport pacing run.
zone._phasesNote: M1-fix pacing: long, roomy middle phases (P2/P3 hold 65 m and 47.5 m, about 30 m between survivors) so fights spread over the match; short, tight late phases (P5/P6) so the endgame resolves quickly. M2c v8: waits P2 60 -> 70, P3 55 -> 65, P4 40 -> 45 (+25 s), because the bot zone-entry fix made bots reach the circle and island medians fell to 341 / 353 s. Balance v9: waits P1 75 -> 60, P2 70 -> 50, P3 65 -> 45 (-55 s), because v8 matches ended mostly in phase 3, P4 started in only about half the island matches (median 2 alive) and P5/P6/collapse almost never played; island sim (30 matches x 30 layout seeds, idle / looter) median 329 / 327 s, P4 reached in 25 / 29 of 30, alive at P4 start 4.0 / 3.0. Pacing target is now median 320-400 s (acceptance 300-480). Every shrink ends at 1:45 / 3:20 / 4:45 / 6:00 / 6:50 / 7:30 (105 / 200 / 285 / 360 / 410 / 450 s), collapse starts at 7:50 (470 s) and closes at 8:10 (490 s). The office uses the same schedule (maps.office.zone.phases). Reasoning in systems/zone.md.
zone._indoorNote: M2b (maps.md 2.2): on indoor maps every zone centre must lie inside the floor rectangle inset by indoorCenterInset metres (replaces the island land check; fallback 50% toward (0, 0)). Island maps ignore it.

bots.difficultyNote: Bots aim at chest height (not heads), need reactionMs after first sighting before shooting, and fire in bursts with pauses. A human who strafes and lands headshots should win most 1v1s; a standing-still human loses. If playtests show bots too strong, raise aimErrorDeg/reactionMs first; if too weak, lower burstPauseMs. Pacing (how soon bots pick fights) is set by the loot phase and eagerness keys below, not by aim.
bots._pacingNote: M1-fix pacing (GDD 10). Loot phase: for lootPhaseSeconds x personality.lootPhaseMultiplier after landing a bot only fights enemies within lootPhaseEngageRange or who shot it in the last retaliateMs, and skips loot within avoidRange of a visible enemy. Eagerness then ramps 0 -> 1 over eagernessRampSeconds (raised to eagernessCurve), with a floor of zonePhaseIndex / eagernessFullAtPhase; engagement range = lerp(lootPhaseEngageRange, max(fire range, minEngageRange), eagerness) x personality.engageRangeMultiplier, capped by visionRange (ads.scopedVisionRange while the bot carries a usable scope_4x/scope_8x gun).
bots._eagernessNote: M2c: 1.5 -> 1.75 (calmer mid-game; the zone floor still forces full eagerness by phase 5). Pacing run 1 with 1.6 gave an island median of 338 / 350 s (target 360-420). Next lever: 2.0, then lootPhaseEngageRange 4 -> 3.
bots._aggressionNote: Balance v10 (pending verification; user asked for more aggressive bots; systems/combat.md 'Balance v10'). Personality shares 0.3/0.4/0.3 -> 0.5/0.35/0.15, investigateChance 0.6/0.3/0 -> 0.9/0.6/0.2, retreatBelowHp balanced 45 -> 30 and cautious 60 -> 45, tactics.investigateMinEagerness 0.5 -> 0.3. matchReport (30 matches x 30 layout seeds, idle / looter, after the bot gun-swap fix): island first kill median 114 / 106 s -> 25 / 24 s, match median 339 / 310 -> 315 / 313 s, alive at P4 start 4.0 / 3.0 -> 3.0 / 3.0; office first kill 18 / 16 -> 14 / 13 s, median 353 / 341 -> 340 / 329 s, fists 8.2 / 7.0% -> 8.2 / 9.3%. Rejected: eagernessCurve 1.3 + eagernessRampSeconds 240, and lootPhaseSeconds 60 + lootPhaseEngageRange 8 (both dropped alive at P4 to 2, undoing the v9 endgame fix).

drop._note: M2b bot jump choice (systems/drop.md 'Bots: jump choice'). Candidates = loot spawns within auto-deploy reach x reachSafetyFraction of the in-window route; weight tierWeights[tier] (x personality dropEpicWeightMultiplier for epic); skip a candidate once maxBotsPerTarget earlier picks lie within bots.dropSpreadRange of it (a pick of the same spawn counts, distance 0). Jump when the carrier passes the closest route point + personality jumpTimingBiasMs + uniform +-jumpJitterMs, clamped to the window.

nav._note: M2b indoor navigation (systems/maps.md section 4). Island maps ignore it (M1 steering). Grid of cellSize cells on the floor and every walkable top, built once per map id, deterministic. A* costs in metres; climb links cost route length x climbCostMultiplier; drop-down links cost dropCost. Path cache of pathCacheSize entries keyed by (start cell, goal cell). At most maxPathsPerTick new searches per tick across all bots. Replan on goal change, when stuck, or every replanMs. Cautious bots pick a plateau hold point inside the next circle with probability plateauHoldChance.

weaponPrefs._note: M2a bot weapon choice (GDD 10, combat.md 'Bots'). In a fight at distance d the bot holds a usable gun whose [minRange, maxRange] contains d (highest lootValue wins ties); if none does, the gun with the best expectedBodyDps(d). Loot upgrades compare lootValue: replace the lower-value carried gun when new lootValue > old lootValue x bots.ai.gunUpgradeFactor.

ads._note: Bots hold ADS while firing when the held gun's sight is scope_4x/scope_8x, or its sight is red_dot/iron and the target is farther than minRange. While ADS, bot aim error x aimErrorMultiplier. A bot carrying a usable scoped gun sees up to scopedVisionRange instead of visionRange. A bot holding a scoped gun fires only at adsProgress >= scopedFireMinProgress (ADR 0004 A1.6), so it never hip-fires a scoped gun.

stance._note: At each strafe change while engaged at distance >= minRange and holding a non-iron-sight gun, roll personality.stanceChance. Success: stop strafing and crouch (or prone with probability proneShare, when water depth allows) for holdMs, then stand. Leave early when hit by an unseen attacker, the target is lost, or the tide is urgent.

grenade._note: Each decision tick, a bot carrying grenades whose engaged target was last seen within coverMemoryMs but is not visible now, at last-known distance in [minRange, maxRange], throws with probability throwChancePerDecision x personality.grenadeChanceMultiplier (at most once per cooldownMs). It cooks cookMs, aims at the last-known position plus a random offset of up to aimErrorMetres, throws, then swaps back. Any bot that can see a live grenade within fleeRadius runs directly away from it.

ai._note: Loot desirability scores are relative and divided by (1 + distance / lootDistanceFalloff). Armor value = (lootScoreVest or lootScoreHelmet) + lootScoreArmorPerTier x tier, only if the pickup would be accepted (armor.md). Steering keys (turn rates in deg/s, zoneUrgencyBufferSeconds) are omitted so the BOT_AI defaults in src/shared/sim/bots.ts apply.

melee._note: M2c (melee.md 'Bots'). lootValue per melee id (fists = the empty melee slot), x levels.botValueMultiplier. A bot picks up a melee weapon (score lootScoreMelee) when its value > current melee value x bots.ai.gunUpgradeFactor. It fights with melee when it has no loaded gun (the M2a fists rule, now with the melee weapon), or when the target is within closeSwitchRange and its held gun's mag is empty. It swings when the target's chest is within range x swingRangeFraction. It chases with melee only within chaseRange, and only an enemy who also has no loaded gun or when no wanted gun is in reach.
melee._tuning: Pacing run 1: about 0.1 swings per match and office fists at 15.6% of kills (M2b 8.4%): bots rarely took melee weapons (30 scored below armor, ammo and heals). lootScoreMelee 30 -> 60 (above a vest, below an unarmed gun), closeSwitchRange 2.5 -> 3.0.

rpg._note: M2c (rpg.md 'Bots'). The rpg is never picked by the weaponPrefs range-band rule. Each decision tick, a bot carrying the rpg with a rocket (loaded or reserve), engaged on a VISIBLE target at distance in [minRange, maxRange], fires with probability fireChancePerDecision x personality.grenadeChanceMultiplier, at most once per cooldownMs, if (a) a collider lies within coverRadius of the target's feet, or (b) another enemy is within groupRadius of the target, or (c) the target's speed < stillSpeed. Never if the aim ray hits anything within selfSafeDistance. Aim point = target feet + target velocity x flight time x leadFactor + uniform offset within aimErrorMetres (seeded). Swap, ADS, fire, swap back. Out of combat it re-equips and reloads an empty rpg. lootValue: loot comparisons only.
rpg._tuning: Pacing run 1: 0.03-0.17 rockets per match. lootValue 3.0 -> 3.6 (bots keep it over an SMG/shotgun), maxRange 50 -> 60, coverRadius 3 -> 4, fireChancePerDecision 0.35 -> 0.6, cooldownMs 6000 -> 4000.

smoke._note: M2c (smoke.md 'Bots'). Bots treat live clouds as opaque in every line-of-sight test (segment vs sphere of the current opaque radius), except between points closer than items.smoke.cloud.closeSightRange. Throw (quick, no aim time, at most once per cooldownMs): on entering Retreat with probability retreatThrowChance x personality.smokeChanceMultiplier, at the point throwDistance metres from the bot toward the attacker; while escaping the zone after taking damage in the last recentDamageMs, with probability zoneCrossThrowChance x smokeChanceMultiplier, at the same kind of point. lootScoreSmoke: a smoke stack while below items.smoke.maxCarry.
smoke._tuning: Pacing run 1: 0.6-1.2 smokes thrown per match of about 4.5 spawned. lootScoreSmoke 14 -> 20, retreatThrowChance 0.6 -> 0.9, zoneCrossThrowChance 0.4 -> 0.7, cooldownMs 15000 -> 10000.

scopes._note: M2c (scopes.md 'Bots'). Bots pick up a scope (score lootScoreScope) only when it would auto-mount on a carried gun (rank higher than that gun's current sight); they never stash spares and never press T. mountedMaxRangeMultiplier: while a gun has a MOUNTED scope, its weaponPrefs maxRange x this (default sights x1). ADS: scope_2x behaves like red_dot/iron in the bots.ads rule (ADS beyond bots.ads.minRange); scope_4x/scope_8x as today (always ADS, scopedFireMinProgress, scopedVisionRange), whether default or mounted.

tactics._note: GDD 10 'Tactics' (consumer: src/shared/sim/bots.ts). COVER: a spot behind a collider (within coverSearchRadius, the coverMaxCandidates nearest, at least crouch-high and as wide as a player) that hides the bot from the threat's eye, standing or crouched; score = walk distance + coverTowardThreatPenalty x metres closer to the threat (+ a small crouch penalty). At most one search per bot per coverSearchCooldownMs (and a per-tick cap across bots). Reasons: (heal) the Retreat trigger goes to cover and heals once hidden, until healed; (reload) a reload with >= coverReloadMinMs left, within the distance it can walk before the reload ends; (under fire) hit by an enemy it cannot answer (out of sight or beyond its best fire range): hold coverHoldMs, then coverCooldownMs before the next. Any cover ends after coverMaxMs or when the threat can see the spot (a new search is tried). In cover the bot pre-aims the threat's last known position, then peeks back out (chases the last known position). RANGE PLAN: damage share(d) = myBestDps(d) / (myBestDps(d) + enemyHeldDps(d)), sampled up to the bot's best fire range; when the best share beats the current one by rangeAdvantageMargin the bot moves to the nearest distance within rangeAdvantageMargin of the best (closing in or backing off), else it keeps the weapon's preferred range. RELOADS: an empty or reloading gun with a visible enemy within swapInsteadOfReloadRange and a loaded second gun: swap; target out of sight: reload below hiddenReloadFraction of the mag; out of combat: top up the other gun too. PRESSURE: a visible enemy who is reloading or healing is pushed into the held gun's full-damage range; a target that broke sight within pushWindowMs of this bot hitting it is chased at a sprint; out of sight, bots pre-aim the last known position. EVASION: hitJukeChance to flip strafe when hit. INVESTIGATE: gunfire within hearingRange, rolled once per investigateMemoryMs with personality.investigateChance at eagerness >= investigateMinEagerness, sends an armed bot with nothing to loot toward the shot, stopping at investigateStandoffFraction x its best fire range, only inside the safe circle.

clientFeel._note: Client presentation only, never sim rules (consumer: src/game/tuning.ts). Distances in m, angles in degrees, times in ms. M2b: the on-foot, freefall, parachute and spectate camera is FIRST PERSON (systems/camera.md); fp* = first-person camera, vm* = viewmodel, fpRecoil.<weaponId> = visual-only recoil. Third-person keys cameraDistance, cameraShoulderOffset (< 0.6), cameraFovDeg (vertical) and orbit* now apply ONLY to the 3P cases (aboard orbit, death cam, V chase spectate, results).
clientFeel._carrierNote: M2b: carrierCameraDistance = the 3P orbit distance (m) from the carrier while aboard (CameraView view 'carrier', ADR 0005 section 8). Base 26 frames the seaplane (22.6 m wingspan) at cameraFovDeg 70; maps.office.clientFeel overrides it to 10 for the 7.7 m drone under the 27 m ceiling. The client must resolve tuning from the per-map balance (mapChanged.balance).

fpRecoil._note: Visual only (camera.md 'Recoil'): viewmodel kickBack (m) and kickPitchDeg, camera rollDeg and fovPunchDeg, all back to rest within returnMs. Never rotates camera pitch/yaw. Automatic fire stacks to at most 2x.

rooms._note: M2b room rules (systems/rooms.md, ADR 0006). Countdown length stays match.countdownSeconds; the map lock is match.mapVoteLockSeconds. Ops limits (MAX_ROOMS, rate limits, list throttle) are server config, not balance. Not overridable per map. Rules: 1 <= minMaxHumans <= defaultMaxHumans <= maxMaxHumans <= match.maxPlayers; minHumansToStartWithoutBots >= 2. kickRejoinBlockSeconds: a kicked player cannot rejoin that room for this long.

office._note: Toy-scale (x9) indoor office (systems/maps.md sections 2-3, systems/drop.md, levels/office.md). drop: toy delivery drone under the 27 m ceiling, short napkin parachute (lands about 2.25 s after the jump, 21 m reach). carrierSpeed 12 -> 15 (Phase C matchReport: median landing 10.9-11.6 s vs the drop.md AT13 target <= 10 s; next lever noJumpMs 1500 -> 1000). movement.fallDamageMinSpeed 18: a 6.7 m desk walk-off or jump-off is safe (safe height 8.1 m). zone: startRadius 140 covers the 234 x 144 m floor (half-diagonal 137.4); same schedule as the island, phase radii 95 / 70 / 50 / 30 / 15 / 5 m. bots: shorter sight down the long aisle, hearing muffled by walls, smaller avoidRange so bots still loot small rooms. loot: more grenades and shotguns, fewer snipers. clientFeel: closer carrier orbit for the small drone.

bots._tuning2: M2c tuning round 2 (pacing run 2): office first kill at 12 s (landing ~8 s), 4 of 12 dead before phase 2, fists 13-14% of kills (target < 9%), idle median 355 s. These are landing brawls before anyone has loot, so the levers spread bot landings and calm the loot phase instead of changing loot: drop.maxBotsPerTarget 2 -> 1 (one bot per landing target), dropSpreadRange 15 -> 20, lootPhaseEngageRange 4 -> 3 (still covers fist and knife reach).
